hits.tldr: Define custom breakpoints using `--breakpoint-*` theme variables in Tailwind CSS.
Migrate from theme() function to CSS variables; use CSS variable names in theme() where needed.
Theme variables in the breakpoint namespace define responsive variants for conditional styling at specific viewport widths.
Override default theme variables by redefining them in @theme or reset entire namespaces with asterisk syntax.
Remove default Tailwind breakpoints by resetting to `initial` and define custom ones.

Use @variant directive to apply Tailwind variants in custom CSS, stacking or comma-separating multiple variants.
Max-width utility classes with predefined container sizes and custom value support.
